title: Multiplication of polynomial sharings
statement: Let $F$ be a field, let $d,e\in\mathbb N$, and let $x,y\in F$ and $f,g$ be functions from the nonzero elements of $F$ to $F$. If $f$ shares $x$ using a polynomial of degree at most $d$ and $g$ shares $y$ using a polynomial of degree at most $e$, then the pointwise product $fg$ shares $xy$ using a polynomial of degree at most $d+e$.
hypotheses_covered: Share functions $f,g$ on nonzero elements of $F$
